name: WF-258 — Seller Response → Negotiation Decision Controller

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const c=String(d.response_classification??d.classification??"").toLowerCase();const counter=Number(d.counteroffer_amount??NaN);const mao=Number(d.dynamic_mao??d.adjusted_mao??d.mao_ceiling??NaN);const asking=Number(d.asking_price??NaN);let decision="needs_review",reason="Negotiation decision requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){decision="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(c==="accepted"){decision="acceptance_ready";reason="Seller accepted the offer.";next="WF-259";}else if(c==="counteroffer"){if(!Number.isFinite(counter)||!Number.isFinite(mao)){decision="counteroffer_evidence_required";reason="Counteroffer and dynamic MAO are required.";next="WF-257";}else if(counter<=mao){decision="counteroffer_within_mao";reason="Counteroffer is within dynamic MAO.";next="WF-259";}else if(counter<=mao*1.05){decision="counteroffer_near_mao";reason="Counteroffer is within 5% above dynamic MAO and requires human negotiation review.";next="WF-259";}else{decision="counteroffer_above_mao";reason="Counteroffer materially exceeds dynamic MAO.";next="WF-259";}}else if(c==="rejected"){decision="rejection_reengagement";reason="Seller rejected the offer; re-engagement strategy required.";next="WF-260";}else if(c==="question"){decision="clarification_follow_up";reason="Seller requested clarification before negotiating.";next="WF-260";}else if(c==="no_response"){decision="follow_up_needed";reason="Seller has not responded.";next="WF-260";}else{decision="needs_review";reason="Response classification requires human interpretation.";next="WF-126";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-258",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,response_classification:c,counteroffer_amount:Number.isFinite(counter)?counter:null,dynamic_mao:Number.isFinite(mao)?mao:null,asking_price:Number.isFinite(asking)?asking:null,negotiation_decision:decision,reason,requires_human_review:["counteroffer_near_mao","counteroffer_above_mao","rejection_reengagement","clarification_follow_up","needs_review"].includes(decision),next_workflow:next,guardrails:{dynamic_mao_primary:true,counteroffer_above_mao_never_auto_accepted:true,rule_70_percent:"secondary_reference_only"}}}];
